channel.title: Parallax
channel.description: Same event, different vantage points. Geopolitical news compared across Western, Eastern, Middle Eastern and Russian outlets.

item.title: United States and China discuss establishing a joint framework for artificial intelligence safety and cooperation.
item.description: How the same diplomatic overture is cast as a quest for global stability in the West and a defensive maneuver against cyber threats in the East.

item.title: United Russia party wins a record majority of seats in Russian parliamentary elections.
item.description: A comparative analysis of how Western and Russian media frame the same electoral mandate.

item.title: Saudi Arabia and the United States respond to escalating tensions and attacks by Houthi forces.
item.description: How Western and Eastern media outlets diverge in their framing of the escalating Saudi-Houthi conflict.

item.title: Israeli President pardons soldier convicted for shooting a wounded Palestinian in the West Bank
item.description: How the same presidential decree is refracted through the lenses of regional identity and geopolitical positioning.
